ab.note: Does this ligature indicate an ους ending?
Does this supralinier "τ" indicate that this is a "τη" ending? I would read this as "τη τριτη"
I am not sure what this combination of letters and the ligature at the beginning of "επισκιαζουσα" means. It looks like it reads "αυτου σκιαζουσα αυτους"
This word "αρτυσετε" as it appears in the base text, looks like it is written with a sigma at the end, "αρτυσετες." What do you think?
It is difficult to tell in this picture, but I think that υιος is spelled in plene and not as a NS? Am I reading this image correctly?
does this look like the scribe wrote ως in place of ουτως?
